svg.title: Incident response under SP 800-61 Rev. 3, with SOAR orchestration and ransomware containment ordering
svg.desc: Two panels. The first maps incident response onto NIST SP 800-61 Revision 3: preparation work sits in Govern, Identify and Protect; in-incident activity sits in Detect, Respond and Recover; post-incident learning lands in Identify's Improvement Category; and Revision 2's four-phase lifecycle is marked withdrawn rather than current. The second covers orchestration and ordering: automation removes handoff latency rather than the decision, every playbook needs an explicit trigger condition and an approval boundary, and the ransomware containment order runs capture volatile memory, isolate at the endpoint agent, revoke tokens, then contain the segment.
svg.text: SP 800-61 Rev. 3 structure, what orchestration actually removes, and why containment order is itself a control.
INCIDENT RESPONSE UNDER NIST SP 800-61 REV. 3 (APRIL 2025)
Response activity mapped onto the six CSF 2.0 Functions
• Preparation sits in Govern, Identify, and Protect: policy and authority, playbooks, out-of-band comms, immutable backups, tabletops
• In-incident activity sits in Detect (analyze and declare), Respond (triage, contain, eradicate), and Recover (restore and validate)
• Post-incident learning lands in Identify's Improvement Category (ID.IM), then feeds back through Govern
• Rev. 2's four-phase lifecycle (2012) is withdrawn — still useful shorthand, but not the current NIST structure
Automation removes the queue, not the decision
• Orchestration removes handoff latency between tools and teams: EDR isolation, token revocation, and blocklist pushes are single API calls
• Every playbook needs an explicit trigger condition and an approval boundary — automated isolation on a false positive is a self-inflicted outage
• Ransomware order: capture volatile memory → isolate at the endpoint agent → revoke tokens and tickets → contain the segment
DETECT AND DECLARE → TRIAGE → CONTAIN AND ERADICATE → RECOVER → IMPROVE (ID.IM), WITH GOVERN CONTINUOUS ABOVE
